items.t: Ranger Energy (RNGR) Lags Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.sum: Ranger Energy (RNGR) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -72.97% and -8.02%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
